name: Smash N' Crash
detailed_description:
Forget everything you learned in driving school. Speed limits? Stop signs? Turn signals? Here, the "rules" of the road are just suggestions. You've gotta win at all costs—whether it's through skill... or by sheer force.*

Vehicle and Weapons

Drive and customize vehicles inspired by real-world muscle cars, supercars, SUVs, and trucks—then arm them to the teeth with deadly weapons and brutal upgrades.** Build your perfect death machine and unleash chaos on the road.

Open World

Don't you just hate when the neighbourhood watch won't stop yelling at you about your reckless driving? If they've got time to complain, then they've got time to dodge a heat-seeking missile—problem solved!* From farm fields to construction zones, rock quarries to busy harbours—tear across highways, dirt roads, and everything in between, leaving destruction in your wake.***

Deathmatch

Twist some metal in arena-based battles where only the strongest survive. Speed might buy you time, but firepower is the only thing keeping you out of the scrapyard. Dodge missiles, unload on your enemies with everything you've got, and make sure you're the last car standing—because if you're not wrecking something, you're not trying hard enough.

Pursuits

As a problematic fella, you've made quite a few enemies. The police, the mafia, the overzealous neighbourhood watch—they all want you off the road for good. You can run—dodging traffic, roadblocks, and gunfire—or you can stand your ground and turn your pursuers into scrap metal. Either way, somebody's getting wrecked.

Races

The finish line isn't guaranteed—your opponents are just as ruthless as you. Outrun them, outgun them, and make sure the only thing crossing that finish line is you... or whatever's left of your ride.

Singleplayer and Multiplayer

Tear up the roads solo or with up to 4 players in split-screen mode. Online multiplayer coming soon.

*Do not attempt in real life

**More vehicles and weapons coming in future updates

***New locations will be added, with existing locations expanded upon in future updates
